subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Phonemic awareness: consonant and vowel substitution (hop to mop)

show.line: Word magic! Hop. Change h to m. Mop! Change o to a. Map! Swap one sound, new word.

rounds.prompt: Cat. Change c to h. What word do you make?
Pin. Change i to a. Tap the new word.
Dog. Change d to h. What word do you make?
Hot. Change t to p. Tap the new word.
Pet. Change e to o. Listen. p, o, t. What word is it?
Bug. Change b to m. What word do you make?

hints: Keep the other sounds the same. Swap just one.
Say the old word, then the new sound in its place.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Cat. I will change c to m.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! c to m makes mat, not bat.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's swap together. Take away c, put in m. Mat!

parent_line: Can change one sound in a word to make a new word.
